claims: On April 5, 2026, the New York Islanders fired head coach Patrick Roy.
On April 5, 2026, the New York Islanders hired Peter DeBoer to take over the head coach position immediately.
The New York Islanders had four games remaining when they fired Patrick Roy and hired Peter DeBoer.
Peter DeBoer was brought in by GM Mathieu Darche.
Peter DeBoer previously coached the Dallas Stars from 2022-2025.
Patrick Roy was hired by the New York Islanders in January 2024.
Patrick Roy had a 97-78-22 record across his tenure with the New York Islanders.
Reports indicate DeBoer signed a multiyear deal to take over the New York Islanders.
Peter DeBoer has over 1,200 games of NHL experience.
Peter DeBoer had previous head coaching stints with the Florida Panthers.
Peter DeBoer had previous head coaching stints with the New Jersey Devils.
Peter DeBoer had previous head coaching stints with the San Jose Sharks.
Peter DeBoer had previous head coaching stints with the Vegas Golden Knights.
Peter DeBoer had previous head coaching stints with the Dallas Stars.
Peter DeBoer has multiple Stanley Cup Final appearances
